gloss: robust cicada (named for its min-min call)

definitions.gloss: robust cicada (named for its min-min call)
definitions.explanation: A large green-and-black cicada with clear wings, named for its loud call in midsummer.

examples.english: I can hear a minmin cicada.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ミンミンゼミ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}いている→鳴く：04388_naku⟧。
examples.english: A minmin cicada is singing in a tree in the park.

examples.japanese: ミンミンゼミ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鳴|な}き{声|ごえ}→鳴き声：16846_nakigoe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: Hearing minmin cicadas reminds me of my childhood summer vacations.

notes:
Its call, ミーンミンミン, is the classic sound of summer in eastern Japan and the way many people imitate cicadas in general. In the cities of western Japan the loudest cicada is usually the クマゼミ instead.
